p: The matter of the blessings for rain on this day:
the bestowal of vitality to the creations;
after Yom Kippur and the festival of Sukkos,
in the heart of the souls of Yisrael,
all seven holy middos in the heart,
of words of Torah in the heart.
וְזֶהוּ עִנְיַן יְרִידַת גְּשָׁמִים בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה:
And this is the meaning of the rainfall on this day:
the bestowal of a drop of life into the heart.
And to this day Chazal alluded
(as is brought in the holy sefer Avodas Yisrael).
וְיֵשׁ לוֹמַר שֶׁעַל זֶה רָמְזוּ חֲזַ״ל
And it may be said that to this Chazal alluded
corresponding to the seven holy middos
that are bestowed with new vitality
in the heart of the souls of Yisrael.
The first: "Great is the day of rain
like the resurrection of the dead";
it corresponds to the attribute of
for the resurrection of the dead is
of the aspect of great kindnesses.
which is of the aspect of Chesed,
we read of the dead of Yechezkel,
for the resurrection of the dead will be on Pesach,
And there is one who says
that the day of rain is greater
than the resurrection of the dead,
"for whereas the resurrection of the dead..." etc.
For the resurrection of the dead is
a renewal of vitality for the body
and this is no great novelty,
because "among the dead" one is free from the mitzvos
But the day of rain is
who in their lifetime are called dead
in his free choice to do evil,
and nevertheless Hashem, may He be blessed,

than the resurrection of the dead in the body.
like the day the Torah was given";
for the Torah issues from Gevurah.
And here too there is one who says
"more than the day the Torah was given."
For the Giving of the Torah,
which was on the festival of Shavuos —
the words of Torah were not absorbed
in the heart of the recipient;
of "we will do and we will hear"
does one merit the Giving of the Torah,
that is, the giving from the side of the Giver.
And it still has no permanence in the heart
as it was the first time,
when the second Luchos were given.
And after the festival of Sukkos,
so that they are absorbed in the heart
than the day the Torah was given.
like the day heaven and earth were created";
it corresponds to the aspect of
Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
שֶׁהוּא כּוֹלֵל שֶׁל כָּל נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל
who encompasses all the souls of Yisrael,
so that no one be cast away from him,
even if one has spoiled much through his deeds.
Hashem, may He be blessed, creates him
like the creation of heaven and earth,
כִּי הָאַיִן הוּא הַמָּקוֹר שֶׁל הַבְּרִיאָה,
For the Ayin is the source of creation,
which is "the head-place of the tefillin,"
the bond of Yisrael at the root;
and this is the aspect of Yaakov.
For in the tefillin of the Master of the world
"And who is like Your people Yisrael,
And this is what was prayed by
David HaMelech, peace be upon him:
"Create for me a pure heart, O God,
and renew a steadfast spirit within me"
which implies there is an impure one
that his heart was not hollow within him
And therefore he asked Hashem, may He be blessed,
שֶׁיִּבְרָא לוֹ לֵב חָדָשׁ וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן.
to create for him a new heart and a steadfast spirit.
And this is the aspect of Shemini Atzeres,
the day of rain, as mentioned above.

for this corresponds to the aspect of Moshe,
who was the first to redemption and salvation.

that is, the spreading of blessing
so that even a coin is blessed,
which is something beyond the way of nature.
And this is of the aspect of Aharon,
as it says, "the beard of Aharon,
which descends over the edge of his garments"
כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה ה׳ אֶת הַבְּרָכָה,

And this is what the day of rain accomplishes:
that nothing be carried off from holiness,
And in truth it is hard to understand:
only because of those who pledge charity in public
is the seventh in the count.
And the implication of the wording is
that even if there were in Yisrael
all the sins besides this one,
the rain would not be withheld for that,
would bring about the withholding of rain.
And in all seven it likewise says,
that all the other sins would not bring about
and they appear to contradict one another.
that Hashem's conduct of His world
הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁבַע מִדּוֹת הַקְּדוֹשִׁים,
is according to the seven holy middos,
when the conduct is through one particular attribute,
as is known to those versed in the hidden wisdom.
And at every time and season
of the other attributes will not bring about
of the attribute that governs at that time.
which is the spreading of goodness
without limit, to the bad and the good.
And when Hashem, may He be blessed,
conducts His world with this attribute,
all other sins will not suffice
the whole generation is liable to destruction.
And through this there would be, Heaven forbid, a flaw
even in the conduct of the great Chesed.

his field does not yield, etc.

And this alludes to what we said above,
the renewed vitality of the words of Torah,
to be absorbed in the heart
on the day of Shemini Atzeres.
And this comes precisely after Yom Kippur,
when there have already been forgiven
that is, all the flaws were rectified
of the souls of Yisrael from the past.
in the seven days of the festival of Sukkos,

to take shelter in Him, may He be blessed;
and this is through the mitzvah of sukkah,
"for they sit under the shade of faith"
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זוֹכִין בִּשְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת
And through this one merits, on Shemini Atzeres,
for holiness to be absorbed in the heart
which is the meaning of the blessing for rain
only if their sins were forgiven" —
and "only because of people of faith" —
